tweets.text: A mixed remote / non-remote team is like dialing in to have dinner with a group of friends in a restaurant.

My guess is that in 10 years we will barely hear about agile. Not that it will go away. But the best parts will be ingrained in how great teams work. And we will do away with all the outdated stuff and tacked-on excess

amazing how flippantly some people use descriptions like "get the most value out of the engineering team"

it may seem innocent and subtle, but the idea of extracting value ... vs partnering to do valuable things ... is an important distinction
Always ask who the mythology serves

Old Guard vs. New Guard

navigating these polarities is critical to scaling a team

Very relieved that SAFE 5.0 now includes OKRs

I will sleep easy tonight.

kind of funny if you think about it

Reading a 4,000 word doc takes about 20m for an average reader, and can convey *so much* context

Yet docs that long are considered end-of-the-world level reads for executives ("they'll never read something that long...put it on one slide")

"what features are we missing"
vs.
"talk me through your day and the other tools you use. in fact, can you show me?"
